## Overview

Sawyer is a single-arm collaborative robot designed to work safely alongside people. Each joint senses force, so the arm can feel contact and move compliantly, and it has cameras in its head and wrist. In the lab it serves as a manipulation platform for testing controllers that must remain safe around people and objects.
